overall_reason: The header collapses to an 'Open menu' button at 375, the 'Coffee shop' to 'Contracts' tabs mark the selected tab with a white pill, and the hero pairs the install command with one secondary 'Read the docs'; the gap is that the hero copy button showed no change in 2 s after it was pressed.

score.reason: T-PRIMARY-COUNT, T-PHONE-NAV and T-WHERE-AM-I on the tab rows pass, but T-STATE-MATRIX finds no copied or failed state on the hero's copy button and no disabled or busy styles in the stylesheet (CMP-128, CMP-002).

visitor_mode: Persuade (inferred: a landing page for an agent design skill whose action is copying an install command; the before-and-after demos such as 'NoteFlow' are labelled exhibits)

findings.title: Copy-to-clipboard swaps its label to "Copied" for ~2.5s
findings.where: button 'Copy: npx skills add Leonxlnx/taste-skill' (hero command box), 1440, async/a0-slow-0.5s.png and a0-slow-2s.png
findings.evidence: The async run pressed the hero copy button and recorded 'responded: false' at 0.5 s and at 2 s, with no new text. a0-slow-2s.png shows the same two-squares copy icon as before the click. The stylesheet declares 0 busy and 0 disabled rules. The same command appears with copy buttons in two more places on the page.
findings.before: Pressing copy leaves the icon and the label unchanged, so the visitor cannot tell whether the command was copied.
findings.after: The icon swaps to a check and the accessible name to 'Copied' for about 2.5 s, and to 'Copy failed, select the text' when the clipboard call is refused.
findings.why: Copying the install line is the page's main action, and a silent copy makes the visitor paste without knowing what the clipboard holds.
findings.root: the copy-command component used in the hero, the install section and the closing section
